title: brachistus inaequilaterus
intro: Brachistus inaequilaterus, commonly known as Mexican clover or deer clover, is a perennial herb belonging to the borage family (Boraginaceae). The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Brachistus inaequilaterus include soothing digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and providing relief from anxiety. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
